scientific_card_excerpt.text: Claim: Let n>=1 qubits start in |0^n> and a reference with H_R=sum_{r>=0} r|r><r| start in any finite-mean state rho of mean mu. Under an arbitrary joint unitary commuting with H_S+H_R, retain all outputs and compare the final joint state with |+^n><+^n| tensor the same original rho, uncorrelated. If D is their trace distance, then for every s>0, D >= exp(-s mu)[1-((1+exp(-s))/2)^n], and D >= n/[8e(mu+n)]. Thus for 0<epsilon<=1/(16e), D<=epsilon requires mu>=n/(16e epsilon). A supplied sine-profile reference and explicit conserving interactions attain D<=min(1, pi sqrt(n(n+1))/(2(L+1))) with mean energy n+(L-1)/2, giving optimal Theta(n/epsilon) scaling for this exact joint-return task.

COORDINATOR DERIVATION: JOINT RETURN OF A FINITE QUANTUM ENERGY REFERENCE
2026-10-10. Internal mathematics; foundational/novelty gate NOT PASSED.
Motivated by round2/05.txt; independently derived below before opening the
2021 Chiribella--Yang--Renner paper. This is a restricted resource calculation,
not an assertion of new physics or a general computing breakthrough.

Model. n>=1 qubits have H_S=sum_i |1><1|_i. The reference R has
H_R=sum_{r>=0} r|r><r| and initial density operator rho with finite mean mu.
Initial joint state is |0^n><0^n| tensor rho. An arbitrary joint unitary U
commutes with H_S+H_R. All outputs are retained. Target is
tau=|+^n><+^n| tensor rho, including the original reference uncorrelated with
all outputs. Write D=1/2||U(initial)U* - tau||_1. There is no discarded energy
reservoir, externally driven nonconserving operation, or uncharged catalyst.
The constructed upper bound takes rho as a supplied resource, not acquired
coherence from an incoherent input. No bound on implementing arbitrary U is
implied; the explicit upper uses n specified two-sector qubit interactions.

1. A lower bound against ALL conserving protocols, not just translated ladders.
For any s>0 the bounded effect exp[-s(H_S+H_R)] is invariant under U. Put
L_rho(s)=Tr(rho exp(-sH_R)), b_n(s)=((1+exp(-s))/2)^n.
Its expectation on the actual output is L_rho(s), while on the target it is
L_rho(s)b_n(s). The variational trace-distance characterization therefore gives

 D >= L_rho(s)(1-b_n(s)) >= exp(-s mu)(1-b_n(s)).                 (1)

The second inequality is scalar Jensen applied to the energy measurement
distribution of rho. It is valid for mixed states and unlimited energy support.
Taking s=1/(mu+n), which is <=1, uses 1-exp(-s)>=s/2 and
 b_n(s) <= exp[-n(1-exp(-s))/2] <= exp(-ns/4).
Since ns/4<=1/4, 1-exp(-ns/4)>=ns/8; also exp(-s mu)>=exp(-1).
Consequently

 D >= n/[8 e (mu+n)].                                         (2)

In particular D<=epsilon implies mu >= n/(8 e epsilon)-n.
For 0<epsilon<=1/(16e), mu>= n/(16e epsilon). Heavy tails do not
evade the linear-in-n, inverse-error mean-energy requirement in this model.
This argument uses a bounded energy witness, avoiding the invalid step of
bounding a difference of unbounded mean energies by trace distance.

ERRATA AND EVIDENCE PRECEDENCE — 2026-10-10

All investigator reports are preliminary research records. A FAIL or
UNRESOLVED verdict is not an endorsement of every intermediate calculation.
The following errors were found; this is not a claim that no others remain.

Precedence: the five retained scoped derivations and this errata index,
then the explicit dated errata and focused audits, then the preliminary
reports. Later errata take precedence over earlier conflicting arithmetic.
Only claims explicitly discussed in a focused audit were audited. Do not
treat a filename containing 'freeze' or a report's self-description as a
cryptographic commitment; version-complete immutable snapshots were not made.

round1/01.txt: A scan-based simulation does not itself prove the invoked
O(t log t) universal-simulation overhead. That overhead must be imported from
an appropriate efficient universal-simulation theorem. No new hierarchy
theorem or self-contained proof of that simulation result was established.

round1/03.txt: For u=a cos(N x_1)(e_2+e_3) on a periodic domain containing
whole periods, ||u||_2^2=a^2 Vol and ||curl u||_2^2=a^2 N^2 Vol. The report's
values were twice these. Energy control is supercritical for the regularity
problem; the terminology 'subcritical' in that discussion must be corrected.

round1/12.txt: A width-w bucket has at most 2*3^w clauses containing either
polarity of the eliminated variable, not 3^w. The larger displayed headline
9^(w+1) bound still accommodates this count. See round1/12_challenge.txt.
The method is standard Davis–Putnam elimination with a supplied width bound.

round1/23_challenge.txt: For pure amplitudes (1,1,i)/sqrt(3), the matrix entry
rho_12 is -i/3, not +i/3 (zero-based labels). Reverse the corresponding block
phase. The phase-alignment principle and adjacent-coherence formula survive.

round1/24.txt: If two rounds each measure points with error at most rho,
true old positions have minimum separation Delta, and displacement is at
most eta, the sufficient nearest-neighbour margin is
2 eta + 4 rho < Delta. The weaker reported 2 eta + 2 rho margin is inadequate
under that measurement model.
